label: Synthesized Marxist value theory with feminist analysis of patriarchal domestic labor
description: Ueno demonstrated that capitalism relies structurally on the patriarchal family to reproduce labor power without wages, establishing Japan’s dual-systems Marxist feminism.
dialecticalTension: Unifies class exploitation and gendered domestic oppression as co-constitutive systems.

label: Expanded existential-feminist critiques of woman as Other into Japanese care and aging sociology
description: Translating and extending Western feminist theory into East Asian contexts, Ueno analyzed how Japanese corporate modernity constructs female care obligations and aging.
dialecticalTension: Applies structural feminist critique to post-industrial East Asian demographics.

label: Inherited early Japanese radical feminist anti-statism in critiquing nationalism and family law
description: In Nationalism and Gender, Ueno echoed Itō Noe’s anti-state critique of Japan’s ie family-state ideology and wartime patriarchal mobilization.
dialecticalTension: Connects Taisho anarcho-feminism to contemporary sociology of nationalism.
